title: Daycare Waitlist Truth Board
oneLiner: A parent-facing and center-facing waitlist transparency board that turns invisible childcare queues into clear next actions.
targetUser: Childcare center directors, admissions coordinators, and parents trying to understand realistic enrollment timing.
keyUx: Centers publish queue rules and available-age-room projections while parents see their readiness status, follow-up tasks, and honest likelihood bands instead of calling every week.
requiredUiSections: Center capacity snapshot by age room and target month
Waitlist queue explainer with sibling priority, readiness, deposit, and response windows
Parent readiness checklist for start date flexibility, paperwork, subsidy, schedule, and backup care
Offer simulation lane for admins showing who will likely accept or ghost
Communication log with templated updates to reduce repeated calls
Fairness audit panel showing rule consistency and manual overrides
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype for “Daycare Waitlist Truth Board,” a two-sided operations tool for childcare waitlists. Include: center capacity by age room, waitlist rule explainer, parent readiness checklist, offer simulation lane, communication log, and fairness audit panel. Design direction: use the field-ops profile with practical scheduling density, clear status colors, mobile-friendly admin controls, and zero decorative fluff; it should feel like a trustworthy operations board parents and directors can both understand.
